purpose: Add durable append-only Activity so an artist can reopen a Song and truthfully inspect what changed across lineage, current/approved decisions, and scoped evidence without another state store or silent history loss.

lineage.outcome: The artist can reopen a Song and understand what changed without losing approval truth or mixing another Song's history into it.
lineage.capability: Durable Song-scoped Activity / What Changed chronology

completion_proof: Song/asset/version/current/approved mutations append ordered Activity in the canonical profile database
scoped evidence claims and explicit reconciliation append Activity without deleting prior claims
Song-scoped retrieval excludes another Song's events
sequence checkpoints return only later events in stable order
close/reopen preserves identical activity references and current-vs-approved distinction
Activity history rejects update/delete mutation and has no silent fixed-size truncation
existing CORE-01A/B state enables Activity transactionally without identity loss
invalid/tampered Activity object references or payloads fail visibly rather than becoming empty history
tests and consumer smoke require no DAW/provider dependency
next_selection_rule: After CORE-01C proof, reconcile evidence and globally reselect from the remaining customer hierarchy. Do not continue database/activity implementation by adjacency.
